correctness.rationale: For n≥3 arbitrary positive cyclic rates, exact inverse factorization gives all R_a entries positive and diagonal F_i=(1-q_i)/(1-P). The log derivative is strictly negative by a product-vs-sum inequality; F_i decreases from 1 to pi_i. The step T=(R_a-(1-theta)I)/theta has positive off-diagonals, conserved columns, and controlled diagonals; this proves all iff cases and equality. The reciprocal-a expansion gives positive coefficient K and the sharp critical divergence. The exact-rational checker independently computes 5346 finite transition matrices and 297 strict comparisons, supplementing the analytic proof. No unproved general-generator extension is claimed.

originality.rationale: Source/claim comparisons of full classical and recent primary results identify only general RK positivity restrictions, symmetric Dirichlet heat-grid theta bounds, distinct [2/2] Padé and filtered-CN Markov kernels. residual_risks: A specialized version could appear in older CTMC numerical integration or positivity literature not captured by the bounded search; no universal novelty certificate is claimed.

value.rationale: Markov master-equation solvers must preserve nonnegative probabilities. The claim gives a complete exact all-dimensional, all-positive-rate classification for a natural nonreversible generator family and all theta in [0,1], including the unique finite failure step, a nonobvious unconditional-positivity boundary below theta=1 determined by stationary mass, and a sharp inverse-distance critical blowup. These are structural, practically interpretable parameter laws, not isolated routine numerical samples.
